-- class: contract
-- name: tighten

-- class: expand
-- kind: add-domain-check
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
alter domain "s_6d7f01ec78ec412286b2ba6fea2b914a"."pos" add constraint "pos_check_next" check (((VALUE > 1))) not valid;

-- class: expand
-- kind: validate-domain-check
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
alter domain "s_6d7f01ec78ec412286b2ba6fea2b914a"."pos" validate constraint "pos_check_next";

-- class: contract
-- kind: drop-domain-check
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
alter domain "s_6d7f01ec78ec412286b2ba6fea2b914a"."pos" drop constraint "pos_check";

-- class: expand
-- kind: rename-domain-check
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
alter domain "s_6d7f01ec78ec412286b2ba6fea2b914a"."pos" rename constraint "pos_check_next" to "pos_check";
